# Sonia Cattaneo

> Communication designer based in Cassano Magnago (Varese), Italy, working
> between speculative design, digital products and editorial projects.
> Graduate of Politecnico di Milano, Scuola del Design. Designs systems that
> use visual language, storytelling and interaction to make complex topics
> accessible, with a focus on design as a tool for awareness and education.

Contact: sonia.cattaneo01@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sonia-cattaneo-b0004b361/
Site: https://soniacattaneo.it/

## Services

Communication, editorial, experience, identity, interaction, speculative,
typographic, UX/UI and web design.

## Selected works

- [Avocartel](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project1/avocartel.html):
  speculative design and interactive installation imagining organised crime
  controlling the avocado market. 2024, Politecnico di Milano. Winner of the
  Interaction & Experience UNIRSM Design Contest 2024.
- [IDgramma](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project2/idgramma.html):
  digital art experimentation on technology, error and visual representation.
  2025, Politecnico di Milano. Exhibited at MEET Digital Culture Center, Milan.
- [UNDO](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project4/undo.html): multiscript
  typeface system integrating Braille with different alphabets. 2025,
  Politecnico di Milano.
- [SCRAPS](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project3/scraps.html):
  independent editorial magazine on economic sustainability and the value of
  waste. 2025, Politecnico di Milano.
- [GLUO](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project5/gluo.html): digital
  service turning diabetes monitoring data into clear guidance. 2025,
  Politecnico di Milano.
- [DUMO](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project6/dumo.html): interaction
  design project on mindful coexistence between human and non-human beings,
  combining sensors, a device and a mobile app. 2025, Politecnico di Milano.
- [Anatomy of Anti-Work Memes](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project8/aws.html):
  information design analysis of 167 anti-work memes posted between 2020 and
  2025. 2026, Politecnico di Milano. Exhibited in "Interdependence" and in
  "Stream, Beef, Vibes" by DensityDesign Research Group.
- [Elty](https://soniacattaneo.it/projects/project7/elty.html): brand and
  communication design for Elty, an Italian health-tech startup — visual
  identity rollout, Instagram and LinkedIn content, Google Ads, and templates
  for GoWelfare and Welbee. 2026, Milan.
